title: DR-20: members skip lifetime checks on received leaves
description: RFC 9420 §7.3: lifetime verification of received LeafNodes (Welcome tree, external-join tree, Proposals, Commits) is RECOMMENDED, not MUST. Readings: (a) members verify (OpenMLS default); (b) members skip on received leaves, like the Observer (mimid-1wgh.4.38). Chosen by Mark 2026-10-17: (b): joining or processing never fails because another member's leaf outlived its KeyPackage lifetime. Leaves we SEND are still within their lifetime (MUST). Signatures, tree hash and all other leaf checks still apply.
